system.description: Physical resilience - the body's capacity to weather punishment, deprivation, disease, and exhaustion. Endure is not about avoiding damage but absorbing it: pushing through pain, continuing to function on no sleep, resisting the early stages of infection, pressing on after an injury that would stop most people. In a world where access to medical care is collapsing, Endure becomes one of the most important survival skills a character can have. It is the counterpart to Resolve, which covers the mind.
system.overcome: Use Endure to push through physical pain or injury; to resist the effects of hunger, thirst, or exposure over time; to shake off the onset of illness; to continue functioning under conditions that are physiologically hostile.
system.attack: It would have be a very extreme situation to use Endure for an Attack, but it would be memorable.
system.defend: Endure may be used to defend against attacks that operate through physical attrition rather than direct force - prolonged exposure, toxins, or conditions that wear the body down.
